population: Keys in RepoGenesis/eval_harness/constants.py REPO_SPECS with lang == python at the pinned revision, parsed as literal data without executing the module.
eligibility_rationale: A deliberately Python-only pilot: local Python is available; Maven is absent and Docker daemon is unavailable. Results do not generalize to the Java stratum. No filtering on requirements, intake, complexity, or outcomes.
ranking: Ascending hex SHA256 of UTF-8(seed + newline + exact case-sensitive task ID), breaking any ties by task ID.
selection: First five ranked eligible tasks, no replacement. Unresolved license or infrastructure issues remain visible and must be resolved before execution or recorded as not run; never silently substitute another task.
order: Selected tasks in ranking order. For zero-based task index even run control then altrego; odd run altrego then control. Each task/arm has exactly one main attempt.
smoke: Separate synthetic service and synthetic oracle, not one of the selected requirements or solutions. Selected-task setup or evaluator probes must be labeled explicitly and cannot be invisible builder rehearsals.
